name: Akuto
source:
An enigmatic figure who uses playful flirtation to charm and mislead at every turn. He's known Shu since their college days, and appears interested in Shu's childhood friend, Cocoro. Originally from Xenoria, he knows a lot about AI, but is shrouded in mystery.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3227510/Algorithm_Prescription/]Steam[/url]]
